attempted_claim: Let S_3 be the closed orientable surface of genus 3, Mod(S_3) its mapping class group, H = H_1(S_3;Z) with a fixed symplectic basis, I_3 = ker(Mod(S_3) -> Sp(6,Z)) the Torelli group, and t: I_3 -> ∧^3 H / H the first Johnson homomorphism with known finitely generated abelian image. Fix the standard 7-curve Humphries chain plus its standard dual fan on S_3 and let F_3 be the explicit finite set of all genus-1 bounding-pair maps T_d T_e^{-1} (d,e disjoint homologous nonseparating curves cobounding a genus-1 subsurface) whose curve pairs are carried by this fixed configuration and whose t-images span (∧^3 H / H) ⊗ Q. Let G_3 be the finite-index subgroup of Mod(S_3) given as the preimage of the principal level-2 congruence subgroup of Sp(6,Z). Decide whether <F_3> = I_3. A complete answer either proves every element of I_3 is a word in F_3 (closing the finite-index gap via t-image lattice spanning plus comparison of H_1(G_3;Q) with H_1(<F_3>;Q)) or proves <F_3> is proper in I_3 by exhibiting a t-image sublattice of infinite index or a finite-index H_1 obstruction; mere lower bounds on word length do not count.
decisive_failure: The explicit F3 curve-pair enumeration, τ-image integer matrix, and H1(G3;Q)/Birman-Craggs-Johnson tables were not supplied and could not be reconstructed in-session; the bounded recovery computation used an illustrative model wedge set. Rational routes were provably exhausted, but the integral/Johnson-kernel gap was not closed, so no generation or properness verdict is claimed.
